sourceRefs.locator: Fr. 8 in Fragmenta Historicorum Graecorum. Naissus and the five deserters, monoxyles and the storm, Bleda’s wife and thanksgiving gifts, encounter with the former merchant at the residence.
p. 31 and n. 5, on Priscus as secretary to Maximinus in summer 449, the sequence of known towns and unnamed villages and the unknown location of Attila’s wooden palace.

note.de: Priskos kam durch Naissus. In der Nähe übergab ein römischer Befehlshaber der Gesandtschaft fünf Männer. Der Punkt markiert die Stadt. Attilas spätere Residenz ist räumlich ungewiss.
note.en: Priscus passed through Naissus. Nearby a Roman commander handed five men to his embassy. The map locates the town. The residence reached later in the journey cannot be securely placed.
